provenance.author: Jonas Helsen
provenance.method: Signed Pauli postselection, two-site Bell contraction, and a Gram matrix bound on the Gaussian-conjugate target plane. The shared certificate regenerates the five-copy exclusion from scratch.

llm.role: Assisted with the lower-bound argument, implementation and independent checks.

notes: The phase state (|0> + exp(i pi/4)|1>)/sqrt(2) is in the leaderboard's H-type Clifford orbit. Starting from chi(H^7) >= 8, the shared certificate excludes a span of 9 atoms at 9 copies. It verifies the local Bell identities and the exact Gram inequality described in research/h7_h9_bell/proof.md. The five-copy base already appears in bounds/qubit_H-m5-lower-6.json. This run independently generates all of its input dictionaries, retains 224 five-qubit rays and checks 173223 five-dimensional candidate spaces. No stored search batches are used.
